g.text: Version the evaluation contract with the decision
A judge or rubric change can alter reported quality even when the agent is unchanged.
ILLUSTRATIVE SCHEMA / NOT A RUNNABLE FRAMEWORK

task: draft_review_packet snapshot: approved_inputs_v1 acceptance: reviewed_complete_output critical: unauthorized_access, unsupported_number cases: common, missing, difficult, regression judge: model + rubric + threshold + version compare: baseline_vs_candidate decision: accountable_owner
Outputs, action limits and clarification/abstention. Unauthorized access fails; correct refusal can succeed.
Version the evaluator, not only the system
Retain judge model, prompt, rubric and threshold. Recalibrate on reviewed cases when they or users change.
Model choice, less review and greater execution authority require different evidence. Finite tests support a scoped judgment with known limits, not proof of zero failure.
Proposed schema informed by Ramp and the system-failure discussion. Adapt the contract to the actual task and consequence.
